prompt.name: Cérémonie Diamond Dogs
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. KAZUHIRA MILLER in the 1984 MGSV The Phantom Pain period, original gala outfit “Cérémonie Diamond Dogs”. Preserve his aged angular face, shoulder-length ash-blond hair, black sunglasses and brown military beret identity from the reference. IMPORTANT anatomy correction: the new sprite must retain his MISSING RIGHT ARM and MISSING LEFT LOWER LEG, unlike the inaccurate two-boot inherited atlas. No biological or bionic replacement of those missing limbs. His empty short right jacket sleeve is neatly pinned; the left trouser leg is folded/pinned just below the knee with NO second foot. His remaining LEFT arm in a black glove supports ONE realistic metal forearm crutch with cuff and grip; his remaining RIGHT leg/boot and crutch are planted securely. Tailored BLACK ceremonial jacket and trousers, ochre waistcoat, ivory shirt, slim dark tie, restrained ochre trim and small lapel insignia. Do not add the old long tan trench coat. Keep clothing dignified and practical, no wound or injury detail. One coherent full-body neutral standing pose, three-quarter right view, crutch fully visible.

visualReview.description: 1984 Kaz gala identity with missing right arm/left lower leg, single left forearm crutch and right support boot.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: missing right arm with neatly pinned empty sleeve; missing left lower leg with folded trouser cuff, no second foot; one intact right boot and one left forearm crutch. Period remains MGSV1984, distinct from PW.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
